author: reek
body: Instancing from Codex [Device] AST: a 5x5 grid of shaded cubes, ray-cast per pixel. Each thread inverse-rotates its ray about Y (so the whole field spins), then folds over the 25 instances -- for each it translates the ray into that instance's local frame and slab-tests the box -- keeping the nearest hit. The winner is re-tested to recover the entry face for its normal, then shaded with a key light and a per-instance colour. The instance fold is a tail recursion the plug lowers to a WGSL loop. This is the reference site's "instancing" technique.
